title: schema-review customization contract
description: Every placeholder the schema-review SKILL.md.tmpl exposes. A profile supplies a value for each. Globals (owner/owner_wants/tracker/chat) are shared across all mnox-ai skills; the rest are skill-local. render_skill.py validates that the template's placeholders and a profile's keys agree.

owner.description: Decision-maker referred to in subject position (e.g. 'the user' / 'Matt'). Used in '<owner> decides' and 'let <owner> choose'.

owner_wants.description: Decision-maker in 'if <X> it durable' position, including verb agreement.

tracker.description: Issue/work tracker name for the never-auto-post rule.

chat.description: Team chat surface for the never-auto-post rule.

validate_high_sev_clause.description: Tail of the high-severity-validation bullet. Local form cites the Trellis feedback rule that mandates it.
examples: — high-severity claims require main-context verification of the full failure/attack chain.
(per the `feedback_validate_high_severity_findings` rule — high-severity claims require main-context verification of the full failure/attack chain).

example_slug.description: Second illustrative slug in the Input section.

dialect_case.description: Lead-in to the SQLite→Postgres dialect example. Local form names the canonical internal project.

verify_rationale.description: Why high-severity validation is mandatory. Local form cites Trellis feedback lessons.
examples: unverified high-severity findings are the most expensive kind of false positive

durable_other_target.description: Where to offer to save a durable report for non-PR targets. Local form points at the dawks artifacts repo.

no_mocking_cite.description: Optional inline citation after the no-mocking rule. Empty in public.

no_local_refs_cite.description: Optional inline citation after the no-local-paths rule. Empty in public.

code_skepticism_cite.description: Optional inline citation after the targeted-fix rule. Empty in public.

idor_cite.description: references/conventions-and-security.md — optional citation after the tenant-isolation CRITICAL rule.

migration_policy.description: references/migration-safety.md — provenance of the atomic-migration-PR rule.
